content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment for 03 (three) months only, likely to be extended for further 03 months Purely contractual; no claim for regular employment under NIHFW No allowance, financial benefits, concessions or medical facilities apart from consolidated remuneration Service can be terminated by either side with one month's notice No private business or professional activity conflicting with Government interest during service
